answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 8 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 75 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The comet keeps the gate honest, the river keeps the farm poor, and the wharf keeps the honest agent paid.
